name: syntenic-orthologs-keep-the-source-organism
turns: Find Plasmodium falciparum 3D7 genes with a predicted signal peptide and 2 to 99 transmembrane domains.
Keep only those with syntenic orthologs in Plasmodium vivax P01.
rationale: A request that keeps the seed's genes by a syntenic ortholog is the seed INTERSECT the orthology transform back to P. falciparum 3D7 over the transform to P. vivax P01 over a copy of the seed, with synteny set on both transforms. The cataloged run bound the phylogenetic profile instead, which has no synteny parameter, and dropped the word: its INTERSECT kept 73 genes where the syntenic round trip keeps 67.

provenance.curatorNote: Two turns on one thread: the first builds the seed, the second edits it. The seed is the one the cataloged run held.
